card.name: Words about origin or cause
card.fires_on: Verbs and nouns that say where something comes from or why it happens, such as owes, source, cause, reasons, explained by. Seen in general prose about history, culture or science.

modes.label: Owes its origin
modes.description: The verb owe/owes pointing to a debt of origin or influence.
modes.example: The modern Japanese comic<< owes>> much to the masters of the Japanese wood

modes.label: Cause or source nouns
modes.description: Nouns like source, cause, causes, reasons that introduce what produced something.
modes.example: - What were the<< causes>> of the Peloponnesian war

modes.label: Explaining by
modes.description: Words that set up an explanation, such as explained or more accurate.
